property_summary: For every call to C's fallback with arbitrary caller and value, the reference contract accepts (does not revert) iff msg.value == 10 ether; the mutant instead accepts when msg.value == 5 ether, so there exist fuzzed amounts where the acceptance behaviour differs (e.g. 5 ether), which the test will detect by checking whether the call succeeded and that C's pastBlockTime only advances on successful calls that sent exactly 10 ether in the reference.
change_summary: Change the require that msg.value == 10 ether to require msg.value == 5 ether so calls sending 5 ether succeed while original reverts.
